name: alignbase
description: Load your team's approved Alignbase context and Skills at session start.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to the context and Skills assigned to the current agent in Alignbase. MCP tools load or manage Alignbase context when the agent has permission. In Codex, an approved startup hook loads context when a session starts.
defaultPrompt: Load the Alignbase context assigned to this agent.
List the Alignbase Skills available to this agent.
